newsitem.title: USA: Three die apparently of suffocation in Calif. motel.
newsitem.headline: Three die apparently of suffocation in Calif. motel.

text.p: The bodies of a couple and a child who had apparently suffocated were found in a northern California motel room on Thursday, police said.
"Three people were found dead apparently by asphyxiation," police in Daly City, 10 miles (15 km) south of San Francisco, said in a statement.
The victims -- a woman aged about 40, a man about 35 and a 2-1/2 year-old girl -- were found by a maid. They were not identified.
Police said there was no evidence of foul play and the case was under investigation. News reports said investigators believed fumes from a heating unit may have caused the deaths.
